subject: Re: Demo cadence — Prospect reassigns LLM workstream to platform migration
body:
-----Original Message-----
From: Anya Kostov <anya.kostov@novalabs.io>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: platform@novalabs.io
Date: Wed, 7 Oct 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: LLM demo — can we pause?

Hi Stephanie / Ben —

Quick heads up from our side: the leadership team has just decided to accelerate a platform migration (multi-team initiative) that pulls several feature workstreams, including the LLM/proof-of-concept we discussed, onto the same delivery sprint. Because of that, our product org is reassigning people and deferring pilots that aren’t tied to the migration.

Given that, we need to put the Redwood demo on hold for now. We don’t want to ghost the work — we expect to re-evaluate during the planning cycle in late Q4 and likely reopen in January — but for the next 8–12 weeks we need to pause external POCs.

Can you pause the calendar invites and mark our pilot as deferred? We’d still like to keep the contract paperwork and price sheet for internal review (sending to procurement), so if you can attach the latest pricing that’d be helpful.

Thanks for understanding — I’ll follow up once we have firmer dates.

Best,
Anya Kostov
Head of Platform Integrations
Novalabs


-----Reply (1)-----
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Anya Kostov <anya.kostov@novalabs.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Oct 2026 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: LLM demo — can we pause?

Thanks for the update, Anya. Totally understand — platform migrations are always all-hands and can change priorities quickly.

Action items on our side:
- I’ll cancel the scheduled demo invites and move the demo into a "deferred" status in our pipeline (NDL-4821).
- Ben, could you attach the latest price sheet and the short integration note so Anya’s procurement and infra teams have what they need?
- Anya, if it’s helpful, we can schedule a 15-minute tech sync with Dev to map any migration constraints (no demo, just a short call) — that might make the eventual reboot smoother. If you don’t want that now, no problem.

If you get an approximate reopen week (even just a month) that will help our capacity planning on Dedicated slots. Otherwise we’ll check back in late November.

Appreciate the transparency — we’ll keep this light on our side until you’re ready.

Warmly,
Stephanie Nguyen
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference


-----Reply (2)-----
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Anya Kostov <anya.kostov@novalabs.io>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Oct 2026 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: LLM demo — can we pause?

Anya —

Thanks for letting us know. I’ve attached the RNW-quick-pricing.pdf (two-page summary) and a one-page note on expected integration touchpoints so procurement/infra can review offline.

A couple quick options so we don’t lose momentum entirely:
- If Novalabs wants to keep a light self-serve evaluation, we can open a trial account with limited tokens and a snapshot model (no infra work) so your product folks can experiment asynchronously.
- If that’s not feasible, happy to queue the POC and set a tentative Revisit date in January — we can set a calendar placeholder now and remove it later if plans change.

Also looping Dev here — Dev, if the platform team would be open to a short 15-min tech check, we can send a calendar invite. If not, we’ll hold.

Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: RNW-quick-pricing.pdf; platform-migration-plan.pdf

-----Reply (3)-----
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Anya Kostov <anya.kostov@novalabs.io>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 8 Oct 2026 10:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: LLM demo — can we pause?

Hey Anya — quick note from the engineering side. I appreciate you flagging the migration — I’ve reviewed the high-level plan you shared to platform@novalabs.io and attached a short integration summary (platform-migration-plan.pdf) that maps where Redwood could slot in with minimal effort.

If helpful, I can do a short 15-minute call next week to walk through where a small sandbox and token-limited trial could be run without blocking your migration sprints. No demo necessary — just a tech checkpoint so the restart is quicker.

If you prefer to keep things quiet while the migration stabilizes, we’ll pause activity and check back in early January as Stephanie suggested.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference


-----Final Reply (4)-----
From: Anya Kostov <anya.kostov@novalabs.io>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 8 Oct 2026 15:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: LLM demo — can we pause?

Stephanie / Ben —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the materials. We reviewed the RNW pricing and the integration note with procurement and infra. For now, we are pausing all external pilots tied to feature workstreams until the platform migration completes. We will re-open the POC queue the week of 2027-01-10; I’ll reach out to confirm a firm date in late December.

Please go ahead and cancel the demo calendar invites and leave the placeholder for Jan (tentative). If Dev wants to share the integration note with our infra leads, feel free to do so now — otherwise we’ll pick this back up next year.

Thanks again for being flexible — we’ll be in touch.

Best,
Anya
Head of Platform Integrations
Novalabs
